title: hieracium murorum subsp. cardiophyllum
intro: Hieracium murorum subsp. cardiophyllum, commonly known as Hawkweed, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the dandelion-like Asteraceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in wound healing and the treatment of skin conditions such as eczema and acne. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpene lactones, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium murorum subsp. cardiophyllum have been found to be beneficial in reducing inflammation, improving wound healing, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties.
